name: org.sophiacommons/directory
title: Sophia Commons: Rudolf Steiner, Anthroposophy, Waldorf & Biodynamic Finder
description: 4,800 Waldorf, biodynamic and anthroposophical places, events, talks, and Steiner's 6,800 lectures

tools.name: search_directory
tools.description: Search Sophia Commons for anthroposophical organizations: Waldorf schools, biodynamic farms, Camphill communities, The Christian Community, clinics, eurythmy, study groups and more. Combine a free-text query with category, country and city filters.

query.description: Words to look for in the name or description, e.g. "kindergarten", "Demeter dairy", "Goetheanum"

category.description: waldorf = Waldorf/Steiner schools and kindergartens; biodynamic = biodynamic and Demeter farms; christian_community = The Christian Community congregations; camphill = Camphill communities; community = other intentional communities; eurythmy = eurythmy and the arts; medicine = anthroposophic medicine; societies = Anthroposophical Society branches and study groups; eldercare = care homes; online = online resources; social_media = groups and channels; science = Goethean science

country.description: Country name in English, e.g. "Germany", "United States", "New Zealand"

limit.description: How many results to return (default 20, max 50)

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: Find anthroposophical organizations closest to a point, sorted by distance. Use the latitude and longitude of a town or address.

category.description: waldorf = Waldorf/Steiner schools and kindergartens; biodynamic = biodynamic and Demeter farms; christian_community = The Christian Community congregations; camphill = Camphill communities; community = other intentional communities; eurythmy = eurythmy and the arts; medicine = anthroposophic medicine; societies = Anthroposophical Society branches and study groups; eldercare = care homes; online = online resources; social_media = groups and channels; science = Goethean science

limit.description: How many results to return (default 15, max 50)

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description: Full public details of one directory listing by its id (from search_directory or find_nearby).

tools.name: find_steiner_works
tools.description: Find Rudolf Steiner's books, lectures and free audio recordings by topic, title, GA (Collected Works) number or year. Returns links to read them on rsarchive.org, listen on rudolfsteineraudio.com, buy them, and the Sophia Commons books page. Texts are not included.

query.description: Topic or title words, e.g. "karma", "bees", "Philosophy of Freedom", "Christmas"

year.description: Only lectures given in this year

language.description: de = give the original German text link first (for German speakers)

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, max 30)

tools.name: steiner_on_this_day
tools.description: Lectures Rudolf Steiner gave on a given calendar day, across all years (1880s to 1925). Good for "on this day" posts, festivals (e.g. 12-25 for Christmas lectures) and anniversaries. Defaults to today.

date.description: Month and day as MM-DD (e.g. "12-25"), or a full date YYYY-MM-DD (only month and day are used). Default: today

limit.description: How many results to return (default 15, max 50)

tools.name: find_videos
tools.description: Find recorded talks, lectures, readings of Steiner and films about anthroposophy, Waldorf education, biodynamics, eurythmy and more, from the YouTube channels Sophia Commons follows (about 200 channels in several languages). Also returns matching channels.

query.description: Topic words, e.g. "etheric body", "biodynamic preparations", "Waldorf kindergarten"

limit.description: How many results to return (default 10, max 30)

tools.name: upcoming_events
tools.description: Upcoming anthroposophical events listed on Sophia Commons: conferences, courses, talks, festivals, workshops and online study groups, soonest first.

query.description: Words to look for in the title, description or organizer

days_ahead.description: How far ahead to look (default 90 days)

limit.description: How many results to return (default 20, max 50)
